# AREX construction record

- Anchor kind: source; task-agnostic repository distillation.
- Anchor z: Ascend/pytorch default branch master at `046934140b96836c3fcef14d0f39ae54dc0a06bf`.
- Q: eight primary operating routes, full tree/script discovery, support
  boundaries, self-contained helpers and attributable source evidence.
- X: exact main Git snapshot plus exact pinned op-plugin representative
  implementation; absent submodules/external CANN internals remain boundaries.
- Construction strategy: reuse-existing; compose distill-ml-knowledge ->
  create-repo-skill -> prepare-repo-skill-env -> verify-repo-skill.
- Decision mode: agent-confirmed full-repository extraction under governing
  Issue #309 and explicit user authorization. Parent approved Stage 1 source
  pin/backend map before detailed authoring.
- Runtime destination: InferRSI candidate source tree; no DisCo managed import.
- Native profile adapter: preserve quoted name/description frontmatter and
  sidecar license/operating-role/visibility; separate scratch export is used by
  integrator for the literal AREX license validator. This is an explicit
  destination adaptation, not an unmodified AREX frontmatter pass.
- G_tilde: root plus eight children with route/composition links, three helper
  resources, root provenance, per-child mechanisms/troubleshooting and existing
  allocator-owner metadata references.
- G: structurally/source-checked candidate only. Backend verification remains
  blocked; no fully backend-verified accepted graph is asserted.
- R: this fixture reports tree and private construction scratch.
- Ownership: author writes only this root and corresponding fixtures; parent
  integrates shared registry/matrices and performs independent review.
- Execution discipline: no original native cases before complete graph
  integration; no source setup, network installer, build or native stress
  script executed during reading. Tiny final source/helper checks are separate.
- Recovery: preserve first source/runtime failure, revise bounded affected
  content and recheck; no automatic device reset or managed import.
- Long-tail boundary: directory discovery is complete while implementation
  reading is bounded. Support table names known entry points and missing
  implementations rather than disguising partial depth as complete coverage.

## Scope and review rubric

Each child must have canonical id, actionable inputs/outputs, mechanism,
ordered steps, validation boundaries, recovery and links that resolve inside
the root. Main and pinned op-plugin readsets must have actual displayed spans,
Git blob digests, checkout digests and normalized text equivalence. Original
license bytes must match Git blobs. Runtime helper defaults must avoid device
execution; malformed inputs must fail predictably. Usability assertion grading
and native/backend statuses remain distinct. Parent owns independent review;
author review is self-review only.
